scripts.docs:build: npm run content:generate && vitepress build docs && node scripts/pre-pagefind.mjs && pagefind --site docs/.vitepress/dist && node scripts/post-build.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run docs:build && wrangler pages deploy docs/.vitepress/dist --project-name=interviewprep-world --branch=production
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run docs:build && wrangler pages deploy docs/.vitepress/dist --project-name=interviewprep-world --branch=preview
